subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the lowest female literacy rate, as per Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**____**.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the 2011 Census of India, **Bihar has the lowest female literacy rate of 51.50%**.
 
• The other states with the lowest female literacy rates are:
 
 
• Rajasthan (57.6%)
 
• Uttar Pradesh (60.6%)
 
• Jharkhand (62.3%)
 
• Andhra Pradesh (63.6%)
 
• Arunachal Pradesh has the highest female literacy rate of 87.4%.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2011 Census of India was the 15th national census of India. It was conducted in two phases, house listing and population enumeration. The House listing phase began on 1 April 2010 and involved the collection of information about all buildings. The population enumeration phase began on 9 February 2011 and lasted for 25 days.
 
• The provisional results of the census were released on 31 March 2011. The final results were released on 29 September 2012.
 
• The main findings of the census were:
 
 
• The population of India as of 1 March 2011 was 1,210,193,422.
 
• The growth rate of the population in the decade 2001-2011 was 17.64%.
 
• The sex ratio (number of females per 1000 males) was 943.
 
• The literacy rate was 74.04%.
 
• The urban population was 377 million (31.16%).
 
• Uttar Pradesh was the most populous state, with a population of 199.8 million.
 
• Sikkim was the least populous state, with a population of 610,577.
